system.description:
Pugilists are brawlers of swagger. While a monk may dedicate themself to a single focused blow, a pugilist will break their fingers and keep punching with the bloody stump.


Iconic Pugilists

• Carl, Dungeon Crawler Carl

• Rocky Balboa, Rocky

• Hellboy, Hellboy

• Stiffener Medick, Redwall


Playing Pugilist

Pugilists are frontline bruisers. Stay in the frontline, even while at low HP.


Action: Attack (Brawl)

Move: Frontline


Training: Brawl

features.name: Fisticuffs
features.description:
You have the Dusted Knuckle Perk, and your Equipped Brawl Weapons have the Defense and Vicious properties.


Further, when you roll any damage dice for a Brawl Weapon, you can either:


• Increase your subsequent Brawl damage dice one size until the start of your Turn.


• Grapple or Shove them if you viably could.

features.name: Rope-a-Dope
features.description: If you reduce damage from a Close Enemy’s attack to 0 with the Defense property of a Brawl Weapon, you can immediately make one attack or Move 5’ without using Speed.

features.name: Haymaker
features.description:
If the result of your Brawl Check for an attack exceeds your Difficulty by 10, the Target is Dazed until the start of your Turn.


The number needed to exceed is reduced by 1 every 6 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Moxie
features.description:
You have Favor on Saves against being Dazed, Frightened, Grappled, or Restrained.


Further, being at 0 HP doesn’t kill you for Cd4 Rounds. Each time you take damage during this time, also roll this countdown die.


At 10th Level, this starts at Cd6.

features.name: TItle Holder
features.description:
You use a d6 for the damage dice of your Brawl Weapons, and they Explode on a roll of 1 or 2.


At 10th Level, this increases to a d8.
